description: Preview of the ten-row staff upsert of staff_batch.upsert; validation looks up each row's existing record (skipStaffRoleGrantCheck). Upsert mix: rows with an even index exist and change fixed cells, rows with an odd index are new, so the file and every 100-row chunk are half new and half existing. Measured by TestStaffImportBatchQueryBudget after two warmups (ADR 0067 addendum 2026-11-08, Messplan N10/N110).
